needs_human.note: The new current-view comparison also changes blocked positions. Example: target path:Videos with URL ?folder=Music/Live. shown = [] and narrowFolders([Videos], 'Music') = [], so the Music crumb, which was a link before the fix, is now plain. Choosing Music would show the same empty state, but the crumb trail would differ ('Music' rather than 'Music > Live'). I8 only restricts which crumbs may be links, so this is permitted. It is still a visible behaviour change that no test names.; Under a multi-folder target, several ancestor crumbs can each link to the same view. Example: sf-two (path:Videos/Study/Math path:Music) at Videos/Study/Math/X, where Videos and Videos/Study both narrow to [Videos/Study/Math]. I8 permits this.; A crumb whose narrowed folders equal the target's top stays plain even though choosing it would show a different view from the current one (for example sf-videos at Videos/Study/Math, crumb Videos). The home crumb reaches the same view. This matches spec §1.5 and is carried over unchanged.; Carried over from r7: while an invalid `folder` is still in the URL, or while droppedAt masks it, position is null for one render, so the home crumb is plain even though the URL holds a `folder`.
